mapper.select: SELECT result FROM life_retrieval_cache WHERE query_key = #{queryKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE life_retrieval_cache SET hit_count = hit_count + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE query_key = #{queryKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO life_retrieval_cache (query_key, query, result, hit_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{queryKey}, #{query}, #{result}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result = VALUES(result), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(hit_count), 0) AS hits FROM life_retrieval_cache
